title: Ali Zaidi
text:
Work Experience

Cofounder & Head of Data Science
EagleSwing August 2025 – Present

Architecting end-to-end computer vision pipeline for automated golf swing analysis using pose estimation (MMPose) and temporal signal processing
Designed GPU-accelerated video labeling infrastructure on AWS (EC2 spot instances, SQS, ECR) with auto-scaling and cost-optimized batch processing
Building product roadmap and leading technical development from prototype to production



Computer Systems Engineer 2
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory June 2022 – September 2025

Led research applying transformer-based LLMs to scientific document analysis, resulting in a published paper on zero-shot data citation function classification
Optimized large language model training and inference workflows on multi-node GPU clusters (SLURM, PyTorch DDP)
Developed internal tools and ML pipelines supporting AI-driven research across laboratory divisions



Computer Systems Engineer 1
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory June 2021 – May 2022

Built deep learning models for genomic sequence analysis, applying convolutional and attention-based architectures to DNA/RNA data
Implemented distributed training pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters to scale model training beyond single-machine limits



Machine Learning Intern
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory November 2020 – May 2021

Developed machine learning models for protein folding analysis, supporting computational biology research initiatives
Managed HPC cluster resources and job scheduling for research computing workloads



Senior Project Manager
Fuze November 2019 – May 2021

Led project delivery for enterprise clients on a cloud communications platform, managing cross-functional engineering and support teams
Mentored junior project managers and established standardized delivery processes



Program Manager
Pharmaceutics International Inc. March 2014 – July 2016

Managed FDA drug submission packages and coordinated regulatory responses for pharmaceutical clients
Oversaw R&D and manufacturing operations for Softgel and Hard Shell capsule product lines
Coordinated cross-functional teams across formulation development, manufacturing, and quality assurance
